message.reasoning_content: We need to identify crimes based on facts: selling counterfeit goods (UGG shoes, insoles) with known counterfeit trademark, amount large (value 165,110 yuan). Under Chinese criminal law, this is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" (Trademark infringement) or "假冒注册商标的商品销售罪". The specific article is Criminal Law Article 205? Actually, Article 205 deals with "侵犯注册商标专用权罪" includes manufacturing, selling counterfeit goods. Also there is "销售假冒注册商标的商品罪" under Article 205, second paragraph. So the crime is "侵犯注册商标专用权罪". Also possibly "非法经营罪"? But the facts only support trademark infringement. The text says "数额较大" which is a condition for criminal liability. So answer: [罪名]侵犯注册商标专用权罪<eoa>.
